_comment: Scenario mode (Settings → Voice First Officer → ECAM Abnormals → Scenarios). Each: id (unique), title, abnormalId (a file in config/abnormals — the FO's response), failureName (ProSim's own failure name as ProSimConnect.getFailures() lists it — see the STATUS page / scenario.listFailures), verified (false until the name was confirmed on your rig; an unverified entry is never armed), phases (where it may fire), weight, severity minor|significant|major (major needs allowMajor), takeoff (armed on the ground on ProSim's after-V1 / takeoff condition; needs takeoffScenarios and the RTO / EFATO features), clearAfterSeconds (a transient the app resets itself), techLogAfter (the shutdown offer's title), decision (the FO's line after the ECAM; {alternate} and {destination} are filled in), wearTitle (an open tech-log item of this title doubles the weight). Edits are picked up live.

scenarios.title: Pack 1 fault
scenarios.decision: Pack 1 is off and pack 2 is holding the cabin — I'd suggest we continue to {destination}, keep the cruise at or below flight level three five zero. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Pack 2 fault
scenarios.decision: Pack 2 is off and pack 1 is holding the cabin — I'd suggest we continue to {destination}, keep the cruise at or below flight level three five zero. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Engine 1 bleed fault
scenarios.decision: Bleed 1 is off, the crossbleed is covering it — I'd suggest we continue to {destination}. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Generator 1 fault
scenarios.decision: We've lost generator 1 — I'd suggest we continue to {destination}, we have generator 2 and the APU available. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Generator 2 fault
scenarios.decision: We've lost generator 2 — I'd suggest we continue to {destination}, we have generator 1 and the APU available. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Left wing tank pump low pressure
scenarios.failureName: Left wing tank pump 1 low pressure
scenarios.techLogAfter: Left wing tank fuel pump low pressure
scenarios.decision: One pump on the left wing — the other one carries it. I'd suggest we continue to {destination}. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Right wing tank pump low pressure
scenarios.failureName: Right wing tank pump 1 low pressure
scenarios.techLogAfter: Right wing tank fuel pump low pressure
scenarios.decision: One pump on the right wing — the other one carries it. I'd suggest we continue to {destination}. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Blue hydraulic reservoir low level
scenarios.techLogAfter: Blue hydraulic system reservoir low level
scenarios.decision: Blue system's going down — we keep green and yellow, no flight-control loss. I'd suggest we continue to {destination}. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Yellow hydraulic reservoir low level
scenarios.techLogAfter: Yellow hydraulic system reservoir low level
scenarios.decision: Yellow system's going down — the PTU covers it from green, we lose some brake and flap authority. I'd suggest we continue to {destination} and brief a longer landing. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: IR 1 fault
scenarios.decision: IR 1 is gone, we're on IR 3 on your side — I'd suggest we continue to {destination}. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Brakes hot after landing
scenarios.techLogAfter: Brake temperature high after landing — inspection
scenarios.decision: Brakes are hot — fans on, and I'd suggest we park with the brakes released on chocks. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Slow cabin altitude climb
scenarios.decision: Cabin altitude's climbing and we can't hold it — I'd suggest we divert to {alternate} with a descent to ten thousand. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Engine 1 fire
scenarios.techLogAfter: Engine 1 fire — engine shut down in flight
scenarios.decision: Fire's out, engine 1 is secured — I'd suggest we divert to {alternate}. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Engine 2 fire
scenarios.techLogAfter: Engine 2 fire — engine shut down in flight
scenarios.decision: Fire's out, engine 2 is secured — I'd suggest we divert to {alternate}. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: APU fire
scenarios.decision: APU fire's out and the agent's gone — I'd suggest we continue to {destination} without the APU. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Engine 1 failure
scenarios.decision: Engine 1 is secured, we're single engine — I'd suggest we divert to {alternate}. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Engine 2 failure
scenarios.decision: Engine 2 is secured, we're single engine — I'd suggest we divert to {alternate}. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Engine fire on the roll (RTO cause)
scenarios.techLogAfter: Engine 1 fire on the takeoff roll — rejected takeoff
scenarios.decision: We're stopped, fire's out — I'd suggest we return to the stand and get engineering out. Your call, captain.

scenarios.title: Engine failure after V1
scenarios.decision: Engine 1 is secured, we're single engine and heavy — I'd suggest we return. Your call, captain.
